sentence: Someone shipping a project without a designer tells their AI agent what they like, and leaves with a name, a logo of their own and a brand book they can send anyone.

unfinished.item: the word 'version' in the list of what you get
the phrase 'work in progress' about the .kothar/ folder

shows: a chat with the agent asking a question with options
reference images in grey and orange
the brand book with the logo, colours and icons

picture.claim: Before you see a logo, your agent writes many ideas, keeps the few that differ, and checks each drawing large and at tab size, version after version.
shows: a list of one-line ideas with most struck out
a drawing improving from v1 to v3
the same drawing at tab size in a browser tab

picture.claim: You get one brand book page by page: the symbol at every size, colours and fonts, the logo with the name, app icons, social images and an animated logo.
shows: pages of a brand book lit one at a time

picture.claim: The same skill folder installs in Claude Code as a plugin, and in Codex, Gemini or any other agent with npx.
shows: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and another agent, each with a tick

icons.why: the mark is solid shapes with soft corners; Phosphor fill has the same solid, rounded glyphs

logos.why: agent logos in their own colours, as the install scene shows them; small beside the name
